label: Abjuration
description: Abjuration spells protect, block, or banish. They create barriers, negate harmful effects, or harm trespassers.

label: Conjuration
description: Conjuration spells transport objects and creatures, create objects, or bring forth creatures from elsewhere.

label: Divination
description: Divination spells reveal information, whether hidden, distant, or in the past or future.

label: Enchantment
description: Enchantment spells affect the minds of others, influencing or controlling their behavior.

label: Evocation
description: Evocation spells manipulate energy to produce a desired effect, often destructive.

label: Illusion
description: Illusion spells deceive the senses or minds of others, creating false images, sounds, or sensations.

label: Necromancy
description: Necromancy spells manipulate life energy, often to drain it, restore it, or create undead.

label: Transmutation
description: Transmutation spells change the properties of a creature, object, or environment.
